stories.h: Moment multi-storey building under construction collapses in Nairobi's Eastleigh
stories.p: A multi-storey building still under construction came crashing down in the Eastleigh area of Nairobi, Kenya, early on Friday afternoon, sparking a frantic rescue operation amid fears that several people were trapped under the rubble. The structure stood along Yusuf Haji Avenue, next to Day to Day Supermarket on 9th Street, in one of the city's busiest commercial hubs. Reports of its height vary, with some outlets putting it at 18 floors and Nairobi police commander Issa Mohamed saying it was about 10. Videos from the scene show slabs of concrete falling and a thick cloud of dust rolling down the street as people ran for safety. Kenya Red Cross teams, Nairobi County emergency crews and police joined the search, and the county said excavators had been brought in to clear debris and reach anyone trapped. Police fired tear gas to push back crowds of onlookers and stop the looting of nearby shops. Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja reportedly confirmed that one person had been pulled out alive, and the search continued into the night. The cause of the collapse is not yet known. It comes less than a week after another building collapse on Moi Avenue in Nairobi's central business district.

stories.h: Peller and Jarvis block each other after live-stream fight, two months into marriage
stories.p: Streamer Peller and his wife Jarvis have blocked each other on social media after a heated argument on a live stream in the early hours of Friday. The row began when Peller said the couple were like a father and mother to Jarvis's younger sister, and should be the ones to guide her and choose who she marries. Jarvis disagreed, telling him that if her family had chosen a husband for her, they would not have picked him, and that he should leave her family alone and focus on his own. An angry Peller removed her from the live and blocked her entire family, repeatedly asking his fans whether it was all because his body is small. Jarvis then blocked him too. Peller later went on his WhatsApp channel, called her a fool for blocking him, and blocked her back. The couple married in August, and Jarvis is seven months pregnant.

stories.h: Nollywood mourns Francis Duru, dead at 57
stories.p: Veteran actor Francis Duru has died at 57 after a brief illness, two years after he lost his teenage son. Old posts about his son, his wife Adokiye and an earlier video where he answered health rumours are now circulating as tributes pour in.

stories.p: The singer shared his thoughts on what falling in love does to a person, following the end of his marriage to actress Uche Ogbodo.

stories.p: Omotola Jalade-Ekeinde's eldest daughter shared emotional details about her personal journey.

stories.p: The Sultan of Sokoto, Sa'ad Abubakar III, held a closed-door meeting with President Tinubu at the Villa. No details were released, but afterwards he reportedly urged politicians to keep the 2027 campaigns peaceful.

stories.p: The publisher shared a video of a woman from the South-West speaking against President Tinubu's re-election and said the strongest criticism is coming from Yoruba people.

stories.p: The President's camp responded to Atiku Abubakar's comments about the ₦10bn Ebola emergency fund.

stories.p: A court has issued a new ruling allowing the case between former Kaduna governor Nasir El-Rufai and the ICPC to proceed.

stories.h: Peter Obi pledges support as NDC supporter is buried in Enugu
stories.p: Obi attended as the family laid to rest an NDC supporter who was killed in Enugu, and promised to support them.

stories.h: Tinubu names ex-DSS boss to chair security institute board
stories.p: A former Director-General of the State Security Service has been appointed chairman of the governing board of the National Institute for Security Studies.

stories.h: State police clears the 24-state hurdle
stories.p: Twenty-four state Houses of Assembly have now voted for the constitutional amendment creating state police, reaching the two-thirds of states the constitution requires. Lagos, Ondo, Ebonyi and several northern states are yet to vote. The resolutions now head back to the National Assembly and then to the President for assent.

stories.h: Ebola: no approved vaccine yet for the strain in Nigeria
stories.p: Health officials say there is no specific vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain behind Nigeria's case. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya said vaccines would already exist if the outbreak were in Western countries, adding that trials of new candidates have begun.

stories.h: Ebola: Swiss say Abuja patient likely caught virus in Uganda
stories.p: Switzerland says Nigeria's first Ebola patient in over a decade, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat in Abuja, most likely picked up the virus on a trip to Uganda about two weeks earlier. The exact source is still unknown and 44 possible contacts are being traced.

stories.h: Ebola: FG says no ban on large gatherings for now
stories.p: The Federal Government says it is not restricting large gatherings at this stage of the Ebola response.

stories.h: NEC backs 90-day plan to ease cost of living, but no details yet
stories.p: The National Economic Council endorsed a 90-day plan to bring down living costs. What it involves has not been made public.

stories.p: Three more stations are being added to the Lagos Blue Line rail route.

stories.h: Edo govt pulls down building linked to suspected ritualist
stories.p: State authorities demolished a property allegedly used by a suspected cultist for organ harvesting and ritual activities.

stories.h: Man jailed 40 years for spying for Benue militia leader Gana
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja sentenced the man after he pleaded guilty to spying for the late militia leader.

stories.h: Mother, children among six dead in Sokoto crash
stories.p: Six people, three of them from one family, died in a road crash in Sokoto involving an overloaded vehicle.

stories.h: Cross River budgets ₦987.8bn for 2027
stories.p: Governor Bassey Otu presented the 2027 budget, with 72% set aside for capital projects.

stories.h: No light? She ironed her outfit with a cooking pot
stories.p: A lady refused to step out rumpled during a power outage and pressed her clothes with a hot pot instead. The video has people laughing and taking notes.

stories.h: Wife screams after seeing husband's watery beans
stories.p: A woman's shocked reaction to the pot of beans her husband cooked has become the internet's favourite kitchen drama.

stories.h: Osimhen under fire from Galatasaray fans after rant at critics
stories.p: Victor Osimhen is reportedly facing a backlash from some Galatasaray supporters after an angry message aimed at his critics, and a club board member has answered him with an open letter.

stories.p: Thieves broke into the Manchester United captain's Cheshire home while he was playing in the Champions League defeat to Como.

stories.p: Nigeria's U-17 women take on the defending champions in a crucial match.

stories.p: The US President criticised the NBA star for not standing still during the national anthem.

stories.h: Massive strikes hit Kyiv hours after Putin agrees to talks
stories.p: Russia launched a large missile and drone attack on Ukraine's capital shortly after Putin signalled he would join fresh peace talks. Zelensky separately said there is "nothing personal" between him and Trump.

stories.p: The Meta boss has reportedly reached an arrangement to pay a proposed California wealth tax without giving up control of the company.

stories.h: Arizona mum speaks after son found alive in hospital morgue
stories.p: The mother of a toddler found alive in a morgue hours after he was declared dead described it as "an unexplainable feeling".

stories.h: Japa watch: Malta sets residence-permit deadline before new tax
stories.p: Malta has set a cutoff for foreigners to apply for residence permits, and announced what foreign residents will pay in tax from January 2027.

stories.h: Makinde defends 2027 run against a sitting South-West president
stories.p: Oyo governor Seyi Makinde, the APM's presidential candidate, reportedly told a party town hall in Akure that the sky did not fall when two South-West candidates ran in 1999, and challenged rivals to match his stamina on the campaign trail. He also took a veiled swipe at President Tinubu.

stories.h: Atiku presses INEC to publish the 103 million-name voters' register
stories.p: ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar says people who checked INEC's portal during the 9–15 October display window reportedly met an empty page. He wants the preliminary register released now and says his party will challenge any refusal.

stories.h: Tinubu kicks off 2027 campaign in Kaduna on Saturday
stories.p: The APC has lined up rallies for President Tinubu in 12 states, starting in Kaduna on 24 October and ending in Lagos on 9 January 2027. Port Harcourt, Jos, Ibadan, Maiduguri, Enugu, Bauchi, Sokoto, Asaba, Kano and Yola are also on the list. Kaduna's deputy governor says the state is ready to host the flag-off, and security operatives have been posted to guard campaign posters and billboards.

stories.h: Obi and Kwankwaso to lead "2 million-man march" in Uyo
stories.p: NDC candidate Peter Obi and his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso are set to lead a solidarity march in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, on Saturday 24 October from 9am at the Water Fountain on Nwaniba Road. Organisers say it was moved from 1 October over security and logistics.

stories.h: Peller and Carter Efe nominated for Best International Streamer
stories.p: The two Nigerian streamers are up against Ashswag, Young Multi and Staryuuki at the 2026 Streamer Awards in Los Angeles on 12 November. Voting closes 31 October, and the public vote counts for 70% of the result.

stories.h: Peller says TikTok has invited him to its UK office
stories.p: During a livestream, Peller said TikTok invited him to its UK office and that he plans to tell them "everything about Africa". TikTok has not confirmed the invitation.

stories.h: Peller and Jarvis share maternity photos
stories.p: The couple, who married in August, released maternity photos showing Jarvis's baby bump. It ends months of mixed messages about whether she was pregnant, after they first confirmed it on a September livestream.

stories.h: Dangote agrees to sit for Isbae U's "Curiosity Made Me Ask"
stories.p: Aliko Dangote said yes to the street-interview show after creator Isbae U visited the Dangote Refinery. Dangote said young people are central to Nigeria's future and that his generation has not done enough.

stories.h: Davido's mountain of food in Kogi gets everyone talking
stories.p: A video reportedly shows Davido served a huge platter of grilled fish, prawns and assorted meat at the Kogi home of former deputy governor Edward Onoja, and fans can't stop joking about it.

stories.h: Salawa Abeni: Tinubu helped save my life
stories.p: The Waka queen reportedly opened up about a period when she could barely walk and credited President Tinubu with helping her get the care she needed.

stories.h: Singer Chichi reportedly survives serious car crash in the US
stories.p: The singer is said to have walked away from a bad accident in the United States. Actress Uche Elendu was among those who reacted.

stories.h: Toluwanisings' death: VDM and Woli Agba blame Nigeria's health system
stories.p: Reactions continue to the gospel singer's death. VeryDarkMan blamed the government, saying the singer reportedly went to seven hospitals during a doctors' strike. Woli Agba said the singer feared Nigerian hospitals would fail him.

stories.p: A cryptic post and an Instagram unfollow have revived rumours that the Tanzanian star and his wife Zuchu have split.

stories.p: The actress said in an emotional post that her marriage to Johnson Maduabuchi is over.

stories.p: The actor was at Lizzy Gold's all-white birthday cruise, and their dance has revived dating rumours.

stories.p: A video from Wumi Toriola's son's 7th birthday has fans saying she took another swipe at Desola Afod. Mo Bimpe was also questioned over the notes she sprayed, which she later called a promotional stunt.
